name: Dwarka Expressway Gurgaon
shortDescription: Dwarka Expressway, Gurgaon is one of the city’s fastest-growing real estate corridors, offering excellent connectivity to Delhi, Dwarka, IGI Airport, NH-48 and major commercial hubs.
longDescription:
Dwarka Expressway, also known as the Northern Peripheral Road (NPR), is one of the most rapidly developing real estate corridors in Gurugram. Connecting Dwarka in Delhi with Gurugram, the expressway offers excellent connectivity to IGI Airport, Delhi, NH-48, Golf Course Road and major residential and commercial hubs of Gurgaon.

The area has emerged as a preferred destination for luxury apartments, builder floors, independent floors, plots and commercial properties. Well-planned sectors along the corridor, modern residential projects, improved road infrastructure and growing retail and commercial development are attracting homebuyers and investors.

Key locations around Dwarka Expressway include Sector 83, Sector 84, Sector 88, Sector 99, Sector 102, Sector 103, Sector 104, Sector 105 and nearby sectors. The corridor also benefits from connectivity to major employment centres and upcoming infrastructure developments.

Whether you are looking to buy, sell or rent property on Dwarka Expressway Gurgaon, NestNeev Real Estate provides property options across residential and commercial segments to help you find a suitable property based on your requirements.
